entries.en: to die; to pass away (respectful euphemism)
to die; to pass away, be gone (euphemism)

entries.zh: 归仙；去世的讳称，谓魂归仙界而去
entries.en: to die (euphemism: to depart and join the immortals)
to leave this world; to die

entries.zh: 沦没；沉沦覆没而死，没世
entries.en: to perish; to sink and be lost, come to an end (morir, acabarse)

entries.zh: 沦亡；覆亡、灭亡，亦指人死亡
entries.en: to perish; to be ruined and die (of persons or states)

entries.zh: 死心；心死而断绝念想、不再存指望
entries.en: to die to the world; to despair, give up all hope

entries.zh: 绝气；气绝身亡，气息断绝而死（如命线中断）
entries.en: to expire; to die as the thread of life is cut

entries.zh: 忧伤而死；汉字栏“短行”与该义对当不明，义待考
entries.en: to die of grief or sorrow; the paired Chinese term is obscure
entries.notes: 西语字头“死于忧苦”明确，但汉字栏“短行”（音写与汉字一致）无死亡义之通行训释，语义无法定夺，故降低置信

entries.zh: 断气；咽气，呼吸断绝而死
entries.en: to expire; to breathe one's last as the breath fails

entries.zh: 饿殍；饿死，死于饥馑（亦指饿死者之尸）
entries.en: to die of hunger; to starve to death (also: a starved corpse)

entries.zh: 无老相；未及老而亡，死时尚无老态（谓早死、夭亡）
entries.en: to die young; to die without the appearance of old age

entries.zh: 命无根；病笃命危，生命无所依根，将死于病
entries.en: to die of the illness; one's life has lost its root (mortally ill)

entries.zh: 作古；已作古，谓人已去世（讳称）
entries.en: to have already died; deceased (euphemism: “gone to the ancients”)
to lose one's life; to perish, be killed

entries.zh: 饭；白米饭，仅以清水白煮之饭
entries.en: plain boiled rice (morísqueta: rice cooked in water only); cooked rice

entries.zh: 烂饭；煮得极烂软熟之饭
entries.en: very soft boiled rice; rice boiled to a soft mash (mui blanda: very soft)

entries.zh: 矛；原字形存疑（或为“弓”），而西语字头皆指头盔，对当存疑
entries.en: morion (open crested helmet); celada (closed visored helmet) — the Chinese side gives a weapon word, “spear” (or “bow”, character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏带 [疑]（矛/弓两读），且 morrión、celada 皆为头盔而非矛弓类兵器，四栏对当存在张力，故降中置信

entries.zh: 铁头矛；“茅”通“矛”，指铁铸头胄，借指西式头盔；首字音写污损难辨
entries.en: iron-headed spear; i.e. a steel helmet — the compiler's rendering of morion/celada (first syllable smudged and hard to read)
entries.notes: 首音写带 T99（污損難辨），首字读音存疑；“茅”为“矛”之通行借字，整体为西式头盔之状译
